dimensionDefinitions.firstCyclePressure: Team first-inning/top-order pressure versus opposing starter early-crack profile.
dimensionDefinitions.starterWindowTraffic: Team early baserunner pressure versus opposing starter command/collapse leak.
dimensionDefinitions.starterWindowConversion: Whether F5 traffic can become runs, using conversion shape plus starter command leak.
dimensionDefinitions.starterCollapseAttack: Offense pressure specifically against a starter-collapse profile.
dimensionDefinitions.bridgeAttack: Offense against the first bullpen/bridge phase, using opponent bullpen leak and reliever command.
dimensionDefinitions.lateAttack: Offense against late innings, including bullpen leak, team state, and late explosion pressure.
dimensionDefinitions.outfieldChaosPressure: Offense hard-contact/carry/sun/park pressure against opponent mistake/outfield leak.
dimensionDefinitions.strandFork: Traffic plus dead-bat/no-conversion tension. High means the game can look alive and still strand.
dimensionDefinitions.powerFork: Batter fire plus carry plus pitcher HR/collapse leak. High means scoring can come suddenly.
dimensionDefinitions.stateShock: Recent-state and mentality pressure that can bend a normal projection.
dimensionDefinitions.firstInningRunState: Game-level first-inning scoring pressure from both team first-cycle vectors.
dimensionDefinitions.f5RunState: Game-level starter-window scoring pressure from both teams.
dimensionDefinitions.bridgeRunState: Game-level innings 6-7 pressure from both team bridge vectors.
dimensionDefinitions.lateRunState: Game-level innings 8-9 pressure from both team late vectors.
dimensionDefinitions.compressedFork: Game-level traffic/dead-zone fork where averages lie.
dimensionDefinitions.phaseWhiplash: Game-level difference between early pressure and late/bridge pressure.
